content: Suapuite awng, note tungah Pathian i tettipanna pualak tu kongpai ciang in, a tuan in thuson thiamna le pilna taw kongpai bua hi.
Banghangziam cile note sungah thinglamte tung a kithat Jesus Christ simngawl, bangma thu dang ka heak sawm bua hi.
Taciang note tungah thaneamna, launa le liing kawm in ka om bua hi.
Ka kampauna le ka thuhilna te sia mihing pilna taw kaizot na kammal hi ngawl hi, ahihang Tha le vangletna i pualakna hi zaw hi:
Tabang in upna sia mihing pilna sungah hi ngawl in, Pathian vangletna sungah ki nga zaw tu hi.
Ahizong pilna sia a picingsa te sung bek ah ka pau uh hi: ahihang hi leitung pilna hi ngawl hi, a bokik tu hi leitung thunei te i pilna zong hi ngawl hi:
Ahihang hi leitung a om ma in Pathian in kote minthan natu in a sekholsa thu ku, tua Pathian i ciimna thuku ka son uh hi:
Tua ciimna sia leitung thunei te kuama in he ngawl hi: banghangziam cile he uh hile, minthanna Topa sia thinglamte tungah khai ngawl tu uh hi.
Ahihang, mit taw mu ngei ngawl, bil taw zong zak ngei ngawl, mihing thinsung ah zong a tum ngei ngawl, Pathian in Ama a itte atu in a sekholsa nate, ci in a ki atkholsa om hi.
Ahihang Pathian in a Thaa tungtawn in kote sungah kilangsak zo hi: banghangziam cile Thaa in Pathian i thuthuk te le na theampo kan siat hi.
Banghangziam cile mihing ngaisutna te sia a sung a om ama i thaa simngawl kua in he thei tu ziam? tasia bangma in Pathian ngaisutna te zong mihing in he ngawl a, Pathian Thaa bek in he hi.
Tu in eite leitung thaa a sang te i hi bua a, Pathian in a thong in hongpiak nate i heak thei natu in Pathian i Thaa a sang i hi zaw hi.
Tua nate sia mihing ki hilna pilna kammal te taw i son bua hi, ahihang Tha Thiangtho hilna bang in Tha taw kisai te sia thaa lam taw ma in i tengat hi.

Ahihang leitung mi in Pathian Thaa thu te sang ngawl hi: banghangziam cile tabang te sia amate atu in mawmawtna a hihi: ama in he zong he ngawl hi, banghangziam cile tabang te sia thaa taw bek in ki khentel thei hi.
Ahihang thaa mi in na theampo khentel a hi hang, ama thu kuama in a khentel thei bua hi.
Topa thuhil tu in kua in ama thinsung he ziam? Ahihang eite Christ i thinsung a sang te i hihi.
